facts.fact: The Leveraged Years says article 6 of CSCA decision 50-26, deliberated on 16 June 2026, bars licensed radio and television from broadcasting AI-generated or AI-transformed election content liable to mislead the public or harm the integrity of the electoral debate, with a narrow labelled exception, for the election period from 15 August 2026.

The Leveraged Years says HACA, the broadcast regulator acting under laws 15-11 and 77.03, regulates licensees under decision 50-26 on AI election content; it does not say who enforces it beyond HACA's supervisory powers.

MAR.note: Nothing stated on government use of AI.

facts.fact: The Leveraged Years says CSCA decision 50-26, article 6, binds licensed Moroccan radio and television to refrain from broadcasting misleading AI-generated or AI-transformed election content; it does not reach online platforms.

MAR.note: Nothing stated on AI in a sector's public system.
Nothing stated on AI built or hosted in the country.

facts.fact: The Leveraged Years describes the CNDP as Morocco's data protection authority, which issued a communique recording its position that law 09-08 already governs AI processing of personal data.
The Leveraged Years says law 09-08 governs how personal data may be processed in any sector and, per the CNDP, already governs AI processing.
The Leveraged Years names the CNDP as Morocco's data protection authority acting under law 09-08.
The Leveraged Years says the CNDP issued a communique stating that law 09-08 already governs AI processing of personal data; no decision on a controller is stated.

MAR.note: Nothing stated on criticism of government, cuts or punishment for speech.
